last.verdict: Strong beat, but investors saw a peak quarter and held back.

reasons.label: Stock trading cooled
reasons.text: Equities revenue was $6.44B, up 72% from last year but 13% below Q2's record.

reasons.label: Bond trading slump
reasons.text: Fixed income revenue fell 24% from the prior quarter to $3.47B.

reasons.label: Smaller deal pipeline
reasons.text: Investment banking fees fell 5% from Q2, and the backlog of pending deals shrank.

story: Goldman has posted three straight record quarters of stock trading, peaking at $7.42B in Q2. Q3 earnings still beat forecasts, but trading and revenue slipped from that peak. Analysts remain at Hold, and the stock barely reacted.
